body:
The fixed-background construction required a floor strictly below K and a tail budget strictly above 1+g(K). This grouped manuscript adds the complete clipped-tilt construction giving r>=K and tail<=1+g(K), with both actual leading transfer eigenvalues tending to one.

All 21 previous proof environments and 20 statements are preserved; one theorem and proof are added. Density-gap shorthand and stale navigation are clarified. Full313 analytical audit and311 document/engineering reports are retained. The public subset explicitly omits one redundant frozen-source archive, whose exact hash and Git referent remain recorded; original evidence remains on D.

Registered judges314 precede detailed integration. No universal optimality, external priority, inherited score, human review or provider independence is claimed. Separate frozen document audit, required CI and unchanged normal merge remain mandatory. Audited owned-Colab paired production, every-page QA, first exact-new-PDF assessment, native linked permission and public byte checks are later gates. No PDF produced or publication claimed here. Source311 and313 integration gates remain unwaived.
